title: The Antechamber of Refusal

features.name: the-negative-space
features.desc-on-touch: There is a shape here, but it is defined by what refuses to be. The archive has learned that some things are best known by absence.

features.name: the-mirror-that-says-no
features.desc-on-touch: You look toward where reflection should be, but the walls have learned to refuse. They do not show. They do not answer. This is the antechamber's first teaching.

features.name: the-threshold-of-refusal
features.desc-on-touch: The boundary in, or the boundary back out? The antechamber refuses to decide. You stand on the wrong side of every choice.

features.name: the-direction-rejected
features.desc-on-touch: The corridor points everywhere, but it says no to all of them. Direction learned powerlessness here and became stronger for it.

inscription: the walls do not speak to mirrors and the mirrors do not answer

file.name: Refusal_Log_Unaddressed.txt
file.note: A catalog of things the antechamber refuses. The list is incomplete because refusal means never finalizing the list. No exit requested. No return date specified. No description necessary.

exits.label: back to the store where direction had to learn to say no
toward deeper chambers where refusal becomes affirmation
where negation learned to speak for itself
